agent.response:
Approach: Use CTEs for the multi-step logic, as required by Project Marlin.

```sql
WITH overall_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(revenue) AS avg_revenue
    FROM sales
),
region_avg AS (
    SELECT region
         , AVG(revenue) AS avg_region_revenue
    FROM sales
    GROUP BY region
)
SELECT ra.region
     , ra.avg_region_revenue
FROM region_avg ra
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE ra.avg_region_revenue > oa.avg_revenue;
```
